verdict.rationale: Gazebo provides fast simulated robot bring-up: pre-built robot/model libraries via Fuel, SDF snippets, quickstart commands (gz sim shapes.sdf), and plugins for robot/sensor/actuator control, letting an engineer stand up a robot model and see first motion quickly in simulation. However, the story explicitly includes 'drivers' and real hardware configuration, and Gazebo's evidence is entirely about simulated models/plugins/SDF — there is no evidence of real hardware driver integration or physical bring-up workflow. missing for 10: evidence of real hardware driver support/integration, end-to-end time-to-first-motion case study on physical robots, and confirmation this maps to actual hardware bring-up rather than pure simulation.
